```{r}
# ==========================================
# Method 2: Spline logistic regression + bootstrap CI for probability contrast (REAL DATA)
# Outcome: adult obesity (Wave IV, BMI>=30)
# Exposure: adolescent MVPA composite (Wave I)
# Model: logit P(obese=1) = beta0 + f(MVPA) + covariates
# f(.) implemented via natural spline basis (df=4)
# Estimand: Delta = P(obese | MVPA=10, Z=Zbar) - P(obese | MVPA=0, Z=Zbar)
# Inference: nonparametric bootstrap percentile CI for Delta
# ==========================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(splines)

source("shared_setup.R")
dat <- make_analysis_dataset("wave1.csv", "wave4.csv")

# ---- Fit spline logistic regression (covariates per essay) ----
df_spline <- 4

fit2 <- glm(
  obese ~ ns(mvpa, df = df_spline) +
    female +
    age_w1 +
    race_eth +
    income_w1 +
    parent_educ_w1 +
    bmi_w1,
  data = dat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# ---- Define the probability-contrast estimand ----
mvpa_lo <- 0
mvpa_hi <- 10

# "Typical" covariate values (Zbar) for the contrast
# Use means for numeric covariates; choose a reference race/eth category that exists.
ref_race <- levels(dat$race_eth)[which(levels(dat$race_eth) %in% unique(na.omit(dat$race_eth)))[1]]

zbar <- dat %>%
  summarise(
    female = mean(female),
    age_w1 = mean(age_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    income_w1 = mean(income_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    parent_educ_w1 = mean(parent_educ_w1, na.rm = TRUE),
    bmi_w1 = mean(bmi_w1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

make_newdata <- function(mvpa_value, zbar_row, ref_race_level, dat_levels) {
  data.frame(
    mvpa = mvpa_value,
    female = zbar_row$female,
    age_w1 = zbar_row$age_w1,
    income_w1 = zbar_row$income_w1,
    parent_educ_w1 = zbar_row$parent_educ_w1,
    bmi_w1 = zbar_row$bmi_w1,
    race_eth = factor(ref_race_level, levels = dat_levels)
  )
}

pred_prob <- function(fit, mvpa_value, zbar_row, ref_race_level, dat_levels) {
  newd <- make_newdata(mvpa_value, zbar_row, ref_race_level, dat_levels)
  as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = newd, type = "response"))
}

p_hi <- pred_prob(fit2, mvpa_hi, zbar, ref_race, levels(dat$race_eth))
p_lo <- pred_prob(fit2, mvpa_lo, zbar, ref_race, levels(dat$race_eth))
contrast_hat <- p_hi - p_lo

# ---- Bootstrap percentile CI for the contrast ----
set.seed(123)
B <- 1000
n <- nrow(dat)
boot_vals <- numeric(B)

for (b in 1:B) {
  idx <- sample.int(n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  db <- dat[idx, ]

  fb <- glm(
    obese ~ ns(mvpa, df = df_spline) +
      female +
      age_w1 +
      race_eth +
      income_w1 +
      parent_educ_w1 +
      bmi_w1,
    data = db,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )

  boot_vals[b] <- pred_prob(fb, mvpa_hi, zbar, ref_race, levels(dat$race_eth)) -
    pred_prob(fb, mvpa_lo, zbar, ref_race, levels(dat$race_eth))
}

ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("Method 2 estimand: Delta = P(obese|MVPA=10,Z=Zbar) - P(obese|MVPA=0,Z=Zbar)\n")
cat("Point estimate Delta_hat =", round(contrast_hat, 4), "\n")
cat("Bootstrap 95% CI =", paste0("[", round(ci[1], 4), ", ", round(ci[2], 4), "]"), "\n")

# ---- Figure: spline fitted curve vs MVPA (covariates held at typical values) ----
mvpa_seq <- seq(min(dat$mvpa), max(dat$mvpa), length.out = 200)

grid <- data.frame(
  mvpa = mvpa_seq,
  female = zbar$female,
  age_w1 = zbar$age_w1,
  income_w1 = zbar$income_w1,
  parent_educ_w1 = zbar$parent_educ_w1,
  bmi_w1 = zbar$bmi_w1,
  race_eth = factor(ref_race, levels = levels(dat$race_eth))
)

grid$p <- predict(fit2, newdata = grid, type = "response")

p_curve <- ggplot(grid, aes(x = mvpa, y = p)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Weekly MVPA bouts (midpoint composite)",
    y = "Predicted probability of adult obesity",
    title = "Method 2: Spline-based fitted obesity risk vs MVPA (covariates held at typical values)"
  )

ggsave("fig_method2_spline_curve.png", p_curve, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
p_curve

# ---- Save results for paper pipeline ----
saveRDS(
  list(
    model = fit2,
    df_spline = df_spline,
    mvpa_lo = mvpa_lo,
    mvpa_hi = mvpa_hi,
    zbar = zbar,
    ref_race = ref_race,
    contrast = contrast_hat,
    boot = boot_vals,
    ci = ci
  ),
  "method2_spline_boot_contrast_results.rds"
)

```
